valmorra,171,98,4	script	Card Seller	638,{
mes "[Card Seller]";
mes "Welcome!";
mes "I can sell you any normal and mvp monster card in the game. Would you like to have a look?";
next;

switch(select("~ A Cards","~ B Cards","~ C Cards","~ D Cards","~ E Cards","~ F Cards","~ G Cards","~ H Cards","~ I Cards","~ J Cards","~ K Cards","~ L Cards","~ M Cards","~ N Cards","~ O cards","~ P Cards","~ Q Cards","~ R Cards","~ S Cards","~ T cards","~ U Cards","~ V Cards","~ W Cards","~ Y Cards","~ Z Cards")){
case 1: callshop "A Cards", 1; end; 
case 2: callshop "B Cards", 1; end; 
case 3: callshop "C Cards", 1; end; 
case 4: callshop "D Cards", 1; end; 
case 5: callshop "E Cards", 1; end; 
case 6: callshop "F Cards", 1; end;

case 15: callshop "O cards", 1; end;

case 17: callshop "Q Cards", 1; end; 
case 18: callshop "R Cards", 1; end;
case 19: callshop "S Cards", 1; end; 
case 20: callshop "T cards", 1; end; 
case 21: callshop "U Cards", 1; end; 
case 22: callshop "V Cards", 1; end; 
case 23: callshop "W Cards", 1; end; 
case 24: callshop "Y Cards", 1; end;
case 25: callshop "Z Cards", 1; end;
}
}
